Mia Lopez: Quick ask  final social plan for Serving Patterns webinar. Need: X thread (3 tweets), LinkedIn single + carousel, 20s teaser, and HubSpot routing. Can we lock owners today?

Jon Park: I can take copy. Proposed post times: X Tue 11:00 PT, LI Wed 10:00 PT. UTM: utm_campaign=serving_patterns_q2&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic.

Casey Wu: I'll build assets: 20s teaser + 3-card carousel. Use speaker headshots in Drive/ServePatterns. Need final hero line and CTA variant.

Riley J: Routing plan: HubSpot form -> list 'SP_Q2'. Registrants -> confirmation + calendar invite. Attended -> SFDC lead status 'Webinar - Attended' + create SDR task. Tag leads with source_social and variant=a/b.

Jon Park: Draft X thread:
1) "Patterns beat hacks: how teams serve LLMs predictably."
2A) "Tech deep-dive: caching + batching."
2B) "Outcome: ~40% unit-cost reduction."
3) "Register: short.link?utm...&utm_content=variantA"

Mia Lopez: We'll run tweet 2 as A/B (tech vs outcome) and tag HS accordingly. Casey, please include burned captions for LI autoplay.

Casey Wu: Uploaded teaser + carousel PNGs to Drive (link). Exported 1080x1080 + 1200x675. Added speaker card in variant B.

hs-bot: HubSpot workflow draft created: list 'SP_Q2' and confirmation email template.

Riley J: I'll import the HS workflow, map SFDC fields, and set automation: form -> list -> confirmation -> calendar. Sharing export for review in 30m.

Mia Lopez: Owners: Copy/AB: Jon. Assets: Casey. Routing/workflows: Riley. Scheduling: Mia. React with :thumbsup: if good.

Jon Park: :thumbsup:

Casey Wu: :thumbsup:

Riley J: :thumbsup:

Mia Lopez: Thanks team  I'll paste final links in #marketing-ops and confirm schedule.
